notes: Default-deny. The target list contains ONLY parties named in the proceedings (each with its case reference) plus the operator's OWN matter, sensors and evidence corpus. No wildcard, no inference, no expansion. A case-scoped list of named parties is not a list of suspects: 60.000 people of Heilbronn have not been charged, and a list of them would be a suspect pool, not a case. A party named in a proceeding is not a suspect. Pattern analysis means counting how the SAME procedural step fails across DIFFERENT proceedings — it does not mean asserting that a person is corrupt. Explicitly NOT authorized: nmap/nuclei/trivy/prowler against any third-party host, any scanning or blocking of persons, any doxxing, any mass surveillance, any collection of new personal data about third parties, any external accusation or report without a named human approver, and any legal conclusion. Every output is an AI-generated draft requiring human review.
